items.note: S2.1 gives (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch wires and quotes the per-invocation y_S+x_S, but calls all three stages 'forward' (paper: forward, inverse, forward, 731-733) and gives no schedule, gates or coefficient cancellation (742-759).

S2.2 states the invariant, the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that only edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} cost; the reason is given in one infer step, not a derivation with sub-steps.

Triple-indicator pairings, orthogonality of neighbours and nested nondegenerate labels are stated, but the loss h per central 3->4 edge, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are absent; S2.4 calls all central-wire edges decreasing rather than only 3->4.
S2.5 states endpoint matrices differing by I_m on every role, the shear H<-H+D, and s=Wm-N+2L<Wm with deficit N-2L>0; the projection assignment and the rank argument are not given.

S4.1 says frame differences are products of translation kernels aI+bX_v and give C tensor on every role, but omits one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, the phase frames C_U and the diagonal/bank corrections.
s<Wm and the bit deficit N-2L>0 are stated, but L<N/2 (100/539), the complex inequality, the deficits eta and the explicit tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent.

Linear-time digit operations and controlled shifts are stated, but S1.2's claim drops the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (only in its quote) and S1.1 omits the cyclic row split into W streams.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 and exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V) are stated, but S3.1 omits that E_1,E_2 are invertible, and the per-pivot three-update interchange and O(V) triangular transforms are not shown.

Route (bit network on row streams, edges paid by rank-many recursive interchanges, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), V/W children) follows 1491-1557, but the conversion of the shear into an interchange (D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D), the condition s/W<m^tau and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule are missing.
S3/S3.4 state O(Vu^tau) for two arbitrary u-bit chunks via padding and high digits as rows; the base-m decomposition and padding to q-ary ranges are not given.

S4.3 gives exactly s child calls on f axes and S4.1 gives H_0=bSCS, but the conjugation by P_M placing kernels on slots, the inverse-child identity and the layer form H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D are absent.
Constant number of whole-chunk cyclic shifts plus repair of an explicitly bounded exceptional set matches 1947-1949, but delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} and the cost bound are not stated.

s calls each on 1/W of the volume and node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) are stated, but the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+..., the leaf cutoff e<d^beta, the row index from q_0 chunks and the condition on lambda' are absent.

Statement (Q_p(Hz), error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, O(Vd^{lambda'}), exact dyadics with O(d^{C_1}) guard bits) matches; route follows the paper, but the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E behind the guard width and the full-layer identity b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D are missing.

Signed-shift roots, DIF H_0 rounds, bit-reversed retained order, layout and cost follow the paper, but character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} are absent.
Evaluation at 2^{4p}, four integer products by the established multiplier and centered read-back are stated; the output Q_p(fg/r) and the cost O(rp log(rp)) are only in the quote or the B header.

Two forward transforms in retained order, pointwise packed products, opposite transform and scale by M, with error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the stated cost, follow 3414-3420; the error propagation is not shown.
P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, its cost and the tensor form are stated, but the condition theta>p/alpha^4 is reduced to 'large enough', P_s,P_t are undefined and the axis-exposure cost is absent.
S7.4 gives the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2 via F^+R=R^{-1}F^+ (3961), but S7.3 gives no chirp formula and no equation QF_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T.
Sizes and prime bounds T/2<S<T are correct, but eta=1/(4d), alpha, the fixed exponents and alpha^4 theta_i>p are absent, and the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime count is not shown.
The isomorphism x->prod x_i^{mu_i} and triangular controlled shifts are stated, but mu_i, the triangular digit formula and the cost are not.
Multiplying coefficient k by zeta^k, zeta=e^{pi i/r}, gives the isomorphism turning negacyclic into cyclic wrap, as at 4303-4319.

Source transform and the step order follow the paper, but the input scale 2^{-b-2}, the conjugate definition of F^+ and Phi^{-1} are missing, and the final rescale is given as S and 2^{2b+4} rather than S then 2^{2b+4}S.
Final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries below 2^{2b} are right; the error chain E_s, E_w through contractions and gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

The seven normalized terms, min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa and the conclusion O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) match; the margin formulas g_i (the minimum is g_2=eps c(1-tau)) and the justification of each row are absent.
S0 only relies on 'nlogn-conjecture'; the liminf argument is not given.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: the bit network gives the interchange recurrence, the complex network gives the simultaneous layer, these feed the synthetic transforms, Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, the assembled algorithm and the cost table. It thins out at the source of the saving: the plan asserts s<Wm and N-2L>0 but never gives the loss h per central edge, L=Ich, L/N=100/539<1/2, s_c, or the explicit tau=1-2^{-50}, and the error chain behind exact recovery is also only summarised.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch wires and triples of a 100-element set appear, but the indexing of data pairs by triples of triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given.
Common frame commuting with a pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1} and edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} are all stated.

Nondegenerate nested labels from triple indicators are stated, but the ambient space F^{otimes3}, and that only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each losing h, are missing (S2.4 says all central-wire edges).
Edge residuals and a rank total are named, but rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N rank-one source exceptions are not stated.
s=Wm-N+2L appears, but L is never defined (L=Ich) and the budget sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L is absent.
The deficit N-2L>0 is quoted, but L/N=100/539 (or 101/539)<1/2, which makes it positive, is not.
Endpoint matrices differing by I_m on every role, giving the shear H<-H+D, are stated.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node are stated.
The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) on V/W children with result O(Ve^tau) is stated, but s/W<m^tau and tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent; conservative verdict.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the frame mechanism, the endpoint identity and the edge-as-recursive-calls step, and names the recurrence, but the quantitative core of the saving (loss h on central edges, rank equals dimension change, L=Ich with L/N=100/539<1/2, and the explicit tau) is asserted rather than reconstructed.
